answer.held_back_by: I don't think anything held me back, because I ended up as PM. The only thing that lagged was STAND, which kept sagging even when I did the honest thing. Maybe the game is saying honesty makes you less popular but gets you paid.
answer.ending_fair_why: I played honestly every year and ended at the top with full integrity, so it fits. The line about the formula being published, so nobody can say they were not told, was a nice dig at the pay debate. It still felt a bit too easy, since I never really lost anything.
answer.chase_next: I'd try the dishonest or corner-cutting route to see whether I get caught, or whether the folder from the background check finally comes back. I'd also like to see what happens if I skip the Invitation to Tea and never go into politics.
answer.play_again_why: It was fun at first, but the later years repeated a lot and my choices never seemed to cost me anything. I'd come back for a different path after a break, not right now in bed.

answer.title_fit_why: The pay numbers and the formula were what stuck with me, and the ending card is all about earnings. I never understood what 'Confirmed & Substantive' meant, since the civil service grades went over my head.
